mapper.select: select max(pu.Pup_Sort) from SYS_Position_User_P pu left join SYS_Position_P p on pu.PP_ID=p.PP_ID where p.PD_ID=#{pdId}

select pu.pup_id as pupId, p.PP_ID as ppId, p.pp_name as ppName, p.pp_code as ppCode, d.Pd_ID as pdId, d.PD_Code as pdCode, c1.C_Name as cName, u.u_mtel as uMtel, u.u_name as uName, u.U_ID as uId, d.owner_unit as ownerUnit, c2.C_Name as ownerUnitName, d.PD_Name as pdName from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User_P pu on u.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P p on pu.PP_ID=p.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P d on d.PD_ID=p.PD_ID left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=u.C_ID left join sys_company c2 on c2.C_ID=d.owner_unit where d.P_ID=#{pId} and p.PP_Status = '1' and d.PD_Status = '1' and (d.Pd_Code=#{yzdwoCode} or d.Pd_Code=#{yzdwtCode}) order by pu.pup_sort asc
